chapter.verse: Pasian in Noah leh a tapate thupha pia a, amaute' tungah, “Pung un la, tampi pha-in, leitung dim un.

Note hong kizahtakna leh note hong kikihtakna pen leitung ganhing khempeuh huih lak vasa khempeuh, lei lak-a a bokvak khempeuh leh tuipi ngasa khempeuh tungah om ding hi; na khut sungah amaute hong kipia hi.
A nungta a gamtang peuhmah nang adingin an hi ding hi; kung hing khempeuh nang kong piak bangin na khempeuh nang kong pia hi.
A nuntakna, a sisan pen, a sa tawh na ne khawm kei bek ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in nang hong thah leh ama' tungah sihna dan ka pia ding hi. Nang a hong that ganhing peuhmah ka that ding a, a mipihte a that mi peuhmah daan ka pia ding hi.
Mi a that peuhmahte pen, midangte in amah that ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in ama' lim bangin mi bawl hi.
Note, pung-in khang un la; leitungah tampi tak piangkhia un la, tampi pha-in khang un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in Noah leh amah tawh a om a tapate’ kiangah,
“En un, note leh note’ khit-a na suan-le-khakte uh leh,
note tawh a om nuntakna a neite peuhmah, vasate, innsate, note tawh a om leitung gamsa peuhmah, teembaw sung pan-a a paikhia zahzah peuhmah tawh ka thuciamna ka kipsak hi.
Tuiciin tawh nuntakna a nei khempeuh susia kik ngei nawn loin, leitung asusia dingin tuiciin a om kik ngei nawn loh nadingin note tawh ka thuciamna ka kipsak hi,” ci hi.
Pasian in, “Hih in, kei leh note leh note tawh a om nuntakna a neite khempeuh kikal-ah mai lam khang tawntung adingin thuciamna lim ahi hi.
Meii sungah ka sakhituihup ka kaisak a, tua in kei leh leitung kikal-ah thuciamna lim hi ding hi.
Leitung’ tungah meii kong kaisak ciangin meii sungah sakhituihup a kimuh leh,
kei leh note leh nuntakna a nei khempeuh kikal-ah a om ka thuciamna ka phawk ding hi; tuite pen, nuntakna a nei khempeuh a susia ding tuiciin suak kik ngei nawn lo ding hi.
Meii sungah sakhituihup a om ciangin keimah in ka en ding a, Pasian leh leitunga a om nuntakna a nei khempeuh kikal-ah tawntung thuciamna ka phawk ding hi,” ci hi.
Pasian in Noah’ kiangah, “Hih in, kei leh leitunga a om nuntakna a nei khempeuh kikal-ah ka kipsaksa thuciamna lim ahi hi,” ci hi.
Teembaw sung panin a paikhia Noah’ tapate in Shem, Ham leh Jafeth ahi hi. Ham in Kanaan’ pa ahi hi.
Hih thumte in Noah’ tapate ahi uh hi; hihte panin leitung buppi ah a kithehthang mite hong piang hi.
Noah in lokho masa pa ahi hi. Amah in leenggui lo khat bawl hi;
amah in leenggahzu ne-in kham a, a puanbuk sungah bangmah silh loin lum hi.
Kanaan’ pa Ham in a pa guaktangin a omna mu a, a pua lam-a om a sanggam nihte kiangah gen hi.

Tua ciangin Shem leh Jafeth in puan khat la-in amaute gel’ liangko tuak-ah baang uh a, a nung leh lam-un pai-in a pa uh’ guaktang omna khuh uh hi; amaute in maingat lo uh ahih manin a pa uh’ guaktang omna mu lo uh hi.
Noah a zukhamna pan a pilvan’ ciangin ama' tunga a tapa tum pen’ gamtatna thei a,
amah in, “Kanaan in ciamsiatna ngah ta hen la, a sanggamte' tungah silate’ sila hita hen,” ci hi.
Amah in, “ Topa ka Pasian in Shem thupha pia hen la, Kanaan pen Shem’ sila hisak hen.
Pasian in Jafeth tamsak hen la, Shem’ puanbukte sungah amah teengsak hen; Kanaan ama' sila hisak hen,” zong ci hi.
Tuiciin tun’ khit ciangin Noah kum zathum leh kum sawmnga nungta hi.
Noah’ khan sung teng in kum zakua leh kum sawmnga ahi hi; tua ciangin amah si hi.
